tests.name: Semantic versions compare test.10 and test.9 numerically and stable beats prerelease
Release selection includes test releases only in the testing channel and skips drafts
Only official installer asset URLs with SHA-256 and bounded sizes are accepted
All eleven archive fixtures are immutable and invalid packages cannot alter live files
Valid package is verified into staging without changing code or user files
A rejected incompatible replacement preserves an already prepared valid update
Activation installs managed files, prunes obsolete managed files and preserves untracked notes
Interrupted activation restores the old tree and recovery can safely run again
Insufficient backup space and changed staged files are rejected before live replacement
Symlink parents and malicious recovery paths cannot redirect writes outside the plugin
Automatic checking and installation default off; preferences enforce install implies check
Automatic checks never request Wi-Fi when the device is disconnected
Non-modal subprocess checks persist a valid result and leave unrelated pages alone
Prepared background download leaves the running tree untouched until startup activation
Cancelling a worker prevents concurrent replacement jobs and reaps the child
Automatic checks are throttled to a day with one-hour failed-attempt backoff
Update entry stays in maintenance; search works and update subpages inherit no More menu
GitHub release metadata fixture selects the official versioned install asset
Completed installed releases are not offered again from persisted state
Incomplete download length removes the temporary archive
Cancelling a downloader removes its newly prepared update without touching current code
Enabling automatic installation can prepare an already detected release without another check
